Works offline. Uses less data than one WhatsApp voice note a day.

Three habits. No training needed.

  1. 01
    Tap the item when you sell it.

    Your price list is set up once. After that, a sale takes two taps.

  2. 02
    Snap the supplier's receipt.

    Deliveries go into stock automatically, so you know what you paid.

  3. 03
    Read your closing summary.

    Sales, profit and the three items running low, every evening at 8pm.
